title: Campaign Marketing Executive
company: Lloyd Recruitment Services Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Campaign Marketing Executive

Salary: £33,000 - £35,000 DOE

1 day in office and rest WFH

Outskirts of Crawley

Monday - Friday (35 hour week)

12 month FTC

Lloyd Recruitment Services are pleased to be working with a large, award winning B2 C organisation who are looking for a Campaign Marketing Executive to join their team on a 12-month fixed-term contract.

This is a great opportunity for a campaign-focused marketer with hands-on email campaign management experience who enjoys coordinating activity, working with agencies and delivering engaging customer communications.

About the role

You'll be responsible for supporting and delivering targeted marketing campaigns across a range of customer communication channels, with a particular focus on email and CRM activity.

The role will involve:
- Managing and coordinating email marketing campaigns from brief through to delivery
- Working with internal teams to develop effective campaign plans and communications
- Briefing and liaising with external marketing agencies
- Creating and coordinating engaging marketing content and copy
- Supporting audience segmentation and targeted customer communications
- Monitoring campaign performance and using results to improve future activity
- Managing multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously
- Ensuring communications are accurate, on-brand and delivered to a high standard

You'll ideally have:
- Experience managing email marketing campaigns from start to finish
- Previous experience briefing and working with external agencies
- B2 C marketing experience
- Strong copywriting and communication skills
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- The ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines
- A commercial and data-driven approach to campaign performance
- Confidence working with internal stakeholders and external suppliers
- Experience within the travel, leisure, membership or consumer sectors would be advantageous, but isn't essential.

Essential:
- Proven hands-on end to end campaign marketing experience, rather than a generalist Marketing Executive.

Salary: £33,000-£35,000 Contract: 12-month FTC

Extra Information
- Refer a friend and earn a retail voucher worth up to £500!
- Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
- By applying for this vacancy, you accept Lloyd Recruitment Services' Privacy and GDPR Policy.

Lloyd Recruitment Services are acting as a recruitment agency in relation to this vacancy and are an equal opportunities employer.

title: Marketing & Engagement Manager
description:
Brighton Chamber is at the heart of the city's business community, bringing people together to meet, learn and grow.

We're looking for a Marketing & Engagement Manager to join our small, friendly team to help us to grow and develop the Chamber. We'd like someone who will craft our marketing messages and campaigns to engage our existing membership and attract new members, promote our vibrant events programme and funded projects we run to support the city's wider economy.

The ideal person for this role is a marketing generalist, who has a mix of strategic thinking and practical application. You'll deliver impactful marketing and engagement campaigns across social, email, digital, print and PR - working with members and partners to showcase the Chamber and support delivering an exceptional experience for our members.

You'll get to know our members, finding stories to share, and understanding what they need - tailoring marketing messages that help them maximize the benefits of their membership and engage with the Chamber community.

You will work closely with your Chamber team colleagues, leading on our marketing and maintaining systems and process to make the most of opportunities to showcase the Chamber. You'll quickly become an important part of a team that's collaborative and passionate about Brighton's business community.

The key skills we're looking for are:
- A skilled marketeer - understanding how copy, video, design and key messages can persuade and inform and help grow our membership and a thriving business community through campaigns and digital marketing.
- Great communicator - able to create impactful and persuasive content which stands out and showcases the Chamber and our members brilliantly across multiple platforms.
- Organised project manager - happy to move between different types of work and the kind of person who doesn't miss a detail.
- Friendly, confident and enjoys being around people - you'll chat to and follow up members in person, by phone and online.
- Proactive and responsible - takes ownership and make things happen.
- A team player - we're a small team that works best when communicates openly and supports one another to get things done.

A full job description and person specification is available via our website.

Our members, our events and our business community is purposefully welcoming, supportive and inclusive for all - and the same goes for our team, too. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you're not sure whether all your skills and experience match with our job description, we'd still love to hear from you.

How to apply
To apply, please email your CV (maximum of two pages) and a covering letter (max of one page) which tells us how your skills and experience match those required for the role, to Sarah Springford, CEO.

Applications close on Tuesday 20 October at midnight.

Why join us?
- Work in the beating heart of Brighton's business community. You'll be 'in the know' about what's happening (or what's planned) in Brighton and really get to know the city and its businesses.
- This is a job with instant impact - you'll be helping businesses, charities, and social enterprises every day to meet, learn and grow.
- Our HQ is at PLATF9 RM, a fun and friendly co-working and office space in the heart of Brighton. After your induction period, hybrid working up to two days a week is available - when not in the office, time is spent out and about at events and meeting members and people interested in joining.
- Opportunities to develop and grow - we're a small team but we work hard to create opportunities for the team to develop their skills, push themselves out of their comfort zone and get new experiences.
- Build your own professional network in Brighton.
- Location: PLATF9 RM, Brighton (option for hybrid working after 3 months)

Salary: £32-£35 K depending on experience.
Hours: Full time, 37.5 hours
Contract: Permanent
Holiday: 24 days + bank holidays

title: Marketing and Communications Manager
description:
About the Role

This is a mission driven role leading our marketing and communications, focused on visibility and demonstrating impact. Reporting to the Executive Director, you'll be the driving force behind our public voice-crafting compelling campaigns, building relationships, and ensuring our work reaches the people who need us and those who can support us. You'll shape and deliver a unified strategy that connects audiences, supporters, and partners to our mission.

Key Responsibilities

Building Awareness

Working with senior leadership to align marketing with organisational goals.
- Develop a marketing strategy to raise awareness of DPF's mission and services. Recommending and monitoring marketing spend in line with the charity's marketing budget.
- Build brand visibility across the UK dance sector.

Prepare content for online marketing materials including grants/services information with deadlines to apply.
- Collaborate with partners to produce reciprocal social media content
- Grow awareness of DPF across all social media channels including X, Facebook, Instagram, You Tube and Tik Tok.
- Grow and engage our social media community though targeted campaigns

Create and distribute the charity newsletter and other mailshots.
- Create compelling content and visual assets using tools like Photoshop
- Lead on the developing of audio/visual content and further online resources.
- Manage our WordPress website in liaison with our web developers
- Monitor analytics on digital channels and website, recommend improvements
- Evaluate the effectiveness of campaigns. Develop KPIs and regular reporting on marketing and fundraising performance and adjust strategies accordingly.

Ensure all communications are inclusive and accessible, in line with DPF's commitment to equality and the Disability Discrimination Act.

Create physical marketing materials and liaise with external services to ensure quality and messaging adhere to DPF brand.

Represent the charity at forums and dance events as required.

Fundraising Communications and representation

Support senior leadership to align fundraising objectives with organisational goals.
- Manage our Legacy Fundraising online communications. Customise assets and attend online briefings for the annual Remember a Charity 'Will You? Campaign.
- Attend the 'Acting for Others' consortium fundraising events in person and help promote its events online.
- Create messages for donations received via online platforms such as JustGiving.

Data & Compliance
- Maintain accurate records and ensure Data Protection compliance in line with GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) legislation.
- Ensure compliance with the Equality Act 2010 and champion accessibility and inclusion across all communications.
- Ensure any fundraising communications comply with the Fundraising Regulator requirements.

What We're Looking For
- An interest in dance, and commitment to our vision, mission, and Values
- Proven experience in marketing and communications delivery
- Familiarity with digital tools, analytics and Salesforce CMS
- Confident in using MS Office, including Microsoft Sharepoint
- A flair for working with packages such as Adobe Photoshop, Canva
- Knowledge of working with email marketing platforms (preferably Mailchimp), of managing and segmenting data
- Excellent communication, organisation and relationship building skills

What We Offer
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days annual leave + bank holidays
- Pension scheme, 3% employer, 5% employee
- Enrolment into the EAP scheme
- A supportive, values-driven team culture
- Opportunities for professional development
- Joining a small, collaborative team where creativity and compassion drive everything we do.

Why Join Us?

Dance professionals often work behind the scenes, and their challenges go unseen. At DPF, we believe in shining a light on their stories and ensuring they have the support they need. As our Marketing and Communications Manager, you'll help us reach more people, build awareness of who we are and what we do, and build a stronger and more connected dance community.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing & Communications Executive
- Location: Burgess Hill, Head Office
- Job Type: Full-time, 40 hours per week
- Working Pattern: Office-based
- Salary: £32,000

We're currently supporting a client in their search for a Marketing & Communications Executive to join their growing team. Working closely with senior leadership, this position plays a key role in delivering marketing initiatives and supporting wider business growth.

The successful candidate will be involved in creating engaging content, managing digital marketing activities, and supporting commercial objectives through effective communication, creative campaigns, and brand-focused marketing efforts. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their marketing career within a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Support the delivery of the marketing strategy, ensuring consistent branding and tone of voice across all communications.
- Manage and create content for social media channels, keeping the website content fresh and optimised for SEO.
- Develop written, visual, and video content for digital channels, newsletters, case studies, and customer communications.
- Create and adapt marketing and sales collateral using Adobe Creative Suite.
- Support exhibitions, events, and sales activities with relevant communications and marketing materials.
- Maintain marketing activity calendars and assist with updates to the eCommerce site.
- Keep CRM and marketing data accurate and up-to-date.
- Monitor marketing activity and performance, identifying opportunities for improvement.
- Collaborate with stakeholders across the business to identify content and marketing opportunities.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Minimum 18 months experience in a marketing or communications role.
- Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, CRM systems, CMS, and Google Analytics.
- Skilled in creating and editing video and visual content.
- Creative with a keen eye for design and visual communication.
- Strong writing skills and confident in communication.
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
- Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
- Experienced in using AI tools to support research, content creation, idea generation, editing, productivity, and marketing effectiveness.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary and performance-related incentives.
- Opportunities for professional development and training.
- Dynamic work environment with a focus on innovation and creativity.
- Participation in industry events and exhibitions.

If you are interested, please apply as soon as possible.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced marketer to take ownership of a well-established consumer brand, leading integrated campaigns across brand, digital, media and product launches. Working closely with senior stakeholders, you'll drive commercial growth, strengthen brand positioning, and shape marketing strategy within a growing business.

Client Details

A growing multi-brand business with a strong customer focus, operating across both retail and eCommerce channels. The company offers a collaborative, fast-paced environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and play a key role in driving future growth.

Description
- Develop and deliver brand-focused marketing plans that support commercial growth
- Lead integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, content, email and offline channels
- Drive brand awareness, customer engagement and lead generation activities
- Manage product launches and go-to-market campaigns from planning through to execution
- Own brand messaging, positioning and creative consistency across all customer touchpoints
- Monitor campaign performance, analyse results and optimise activity to maximise ROI
- Manage marketing budgets and ensure effective allocation of spend
- Oversee website content and customer journey improvements to enhance performance
- Work closely with internal stakeholders and external agencies to deliver campaigns
- Identify market trends, customer insights and new opportunities for growth
- Produce regular performance reports and recommendations for senior stakeholders
- Champion a test-and-learn approach to continuously improve marketing effectiveness

Profile
- Proven experience in brand and digital marketing
- Strong campaign planning and execution skills
- Commercially minded with budget and ROI experience
- Skilled in stakeholder and agency management
- Confident using data and insights to drive decisions
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Highly organised and able to manage multiple projects
- Experience within retail, ecommerce or consumer brands
- Knowledge of CMS platforms, SEO, GA4 and email marketing
- Familiarity with Shopify, Magento, WordPress or Umbraco preferred
- Proactive, creative and results-driven approach to marketing

Job Offer
- Competitive salary depending on experience
- Hybrid working (minimum 3 days in the office)
- Flexitime and flexible working environment
- 31 days holiday including bank holidays
- Workplace pension scheme
- Life insurance cover
- Employee wellbeing programme
- Educational and professional development support
- Staff discounts
- Free on-site parking
- Casual dress and collaborative company culture
- Regular social events and team activities
- Opportunity to make a significant impact within a growing consumer brand business
- Broad exposure across brand, digital, ecommerce and product marketing initiatives
